summary: 10-week Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship at Caltech; you must secure a Caltech faculty mentor first.
eligibility: Undergraduates; international students can apply to the Caltech campus track (JPL placements are US-only). Non-Caltech students need a Caltech associate mentor.
title: Caltech SURF 2027

prize.description: About $8,110 stipend for 10 weeks, as reported.

notes: Application opens 1 Nov 2026; the deadline is typically late February 2027, so email potential mentors now.
